Agreed — `SET_DOCUMENT_METADATA` was the wrong framing. The protocol concept should be **the host surface's presentation metadata** (window/app/shell), with the browser as one mapping.

## Revised protocol concept

**`META::SET_WINDOW_METADATA` (`0x08`, guest → host)** — an extensible field family, like `META::ENVIRONMENT`:

| Field | ID | Encoding | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WINDOW_TITLE` | `0x0001` | string offset (`B`) | Title of the window/app shell hosting this stream |
| `WINDOW_DESCRIPTION` | `0x0002` | string offset (`B`) | Human-readable description of the current content |
| `WINDOW_LOCALE` | `0x0003` | string offset (`B`) | BCP-47 content locale |
| *(future)* `WINDOW_SUBTITLE`, `WINDOW_ICON`, `WINDOW_MODIFIED` | | | |

Encoding: `A = fieldId (u16)`, `B = string offset` (same relative/arena convention as `SET_TEXT`/`ROUTE`), `C = 0`. Empty string clears the field. Renderer-global, not tree state; survives `META::RESET`; re-emitted on a full snapshot; ignored from proxied origins.

**Renderer mappings (renderer-defined, not protocol-defined):**

| Renderer | TITLE | DESCRIPTION | LOCALE |
|---|---|---|---|
| HTML/SSR | `<title>` | `<meta name="description">` | `<html lang>` |
| DOM client | `document.title` | meta description | `document.documentElement.lang` |
| GTK4 | `GtkWindow` / headerbar title | headerbar subtitle / a11y description | a11y/locale (best effort) |
| Qt | `QQuickWindow::setTitle` | window subtitle / ignore | ignore |
| future TUI/embedded | terminal/OS window title | status line / a11y | locale |

Web-only concerns stay **out** of the protocol: `canonical`, `robots`, sitemap. The web host derives those from the request URL/config, not from opcodes.

## Authoring surface (reactive)

Root-scoped `WindowMetadata` view modifier with signal-backed fields:

```java
root.modifiers(windowMetadata(w -> w
    .title(computed(() -> titleFor(router.path())))
    .description(computed(() -> descriptionFor(router.path())))
    .locale("en")));
```

- Mount emits the initial values in the SSR frame → correct `<title>`/description/lang on first paint.
- Each non-constant field gets an emitter effect; a signal change emits only that `META` opcode (unchanged → zero).
- A route change recomputes the title from the router signal → one opcode → the browser tab/native window title updates live.
- `renderFull()` re-emits the current metadata for resync.
- Rust parity: `Engine::bind_window_metadata(WindowMetadata { title: Option<Signal<String>>, … })`, with the same change detection in `set_signal`.

## Implementation plan

1. **Spec + core + conformance**
   - `spec/OPCODE.md:404` META table: add `SET_WINDOW_METADATA` + field table with renderer mappings described abstractly.
   - `pathland-core/src/constants.rs:113` `meta::SET_WINDOW_METADATA` and `window_field` ids.
   - `spec/CONFORMANCE.md`: opcode vectors (title, locale) and a network-batch string-offset vector.
   - Update `spec/DSL.md` §5 modifier surface with `windowMetadata`.

Understood — the protocol names the **host-surface concept**, and each renderer decides how to expose it. Final design:

## Protocol: `META::SET_WINDOW_METADATA` (`0x08`)

Guest → host, one opcode per field, extensible field family (same pattern as `META::ENVIRONMENT`):

| Field | ID | Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| `WINDOW_TITLE` | `0x0001` | `A = fieldId`, `B = string offset`, `C = 0` |
| `WINDOW_DESCRIPTION` | `0x0002` | same |
| `WINDOW_LOCALE` | `0x0003` | same |
| future: `WINDOW_SUBTITLE`, `WINDOW_ICON`, `WINDOW_MODIFIED` | | |

Rules:
- Rendering-surface metadata, not tree state. Survives `META::RESET`; re-emitted on full snapshot.
- Empty string clears → renderer default.
- Proxied origins' metadata is dropped (an embedded app must not retitle the host window).
- Web-only concerns stay out: `canonical`, `robots`, sitemap are host-owned.

**Renderer mappings** (documented, not protocol):

| Renderer | TITLE | DESCRIPTION | LOCALE |
|---|---|---|---|
| HTML/SSR | `<title>` | `<meta name="description">` | `<html lang>` |
| DOM client | `document.title` | meta description | `document.documentElement.lang` |
| GTK4 | window/headerbar title | window accessible description | ignored |
| Qt | `QWindow::setTitle` | ignored (no native slot) | ignored |
| future TUI/embedded | terminal/OS window title | status line / a11y description | locale |

## Authoring surface

Java (root-scoped, reactive; route titles come from a computed over the router):

```java
root.modifiers(windowMetadata(w -> w
    .title(computed(() -> titleFor(router.path())))
    .description(computed(() -> descriptionFor(router.path())))
    .locale("en")));
```

Rust (engine-level, like `apply_theme` since a `Node` modifier cannot own window state):

```rust
engine.bind_window_metadata(WindowMetadata::new()
    .title(title_signal)
    .description(desc_signal)
    .locale("en"));
```

Reactivity: mount emits initial values (SSR head is correct); each non-constant field gets a signal effect; a route change emits exactly one `META` opcode; unchanged → zero. `renderFull`/resync re-emits all fields. Root-scoped: per-route values must be signals computed from the route, not per-subtree constants.

## Implementation order

1. **Core/spec**
   - `pathland-core`: `meta::SET_WINDOW_METADATA`, `window_field::{TITLE, DESCRIPTION, LOCALE}`, and a no_std `WindowMeta { title, description, locale: Option<String> }` helper shared by renderers.
   - `spec/OPCODE.md:404` command + field table; `spec/DSL.md` §5 modifier; `spec/CONFORMANCE.md` vectors 44/45 (title + locale, ring and network-batch string offsets).

2. **Rust engine + C ABI**
   - `pathland-engine/src/engine.rs:110/:311`: metadata bindings, last-emitted dedupe, emission in `emit` (mount) and `set_signal` (computed deps included).
   - `pathland-view-native/src/capi.rs`: `pathland_native_window_metadata(host, field, signal)`.
   - `pathland-view` needs no tree modifier; the engine API is the Rust authoring surface.

3. **Java DSL/emitter**
   - `WindowMetadata implements ViewModifier` + `Modifiers.windowMetadata(...)`; wrapper records into `Environment` (package-private setter, public getter for the emitter).
   - `Emitter.java:138`: emit after theme, register per-field effects, dedupe, re-emit in `renderFull`.
   - `OpcodeSink`/`FrameOpcodeSink`/`ffm/RingOpcodeSink`: `setWindowMetadata(field, value)` (relative string table vs arena).
   - `Commands.Meta.SET_WINDOW_METADATA`, `WindowFields`.

4. **Renderers**
   - `pathland-render-core/src/host.rs`: `RenderTree` keeps `WindowMeta`; handle META. Shared by GTK/Qt.
   - HTML `pathland-render-html/src/lib.rs`: decode into head — `<html lang>` (default `en`), `<title>` (default `Pathland`), `<meta name="description">`; escape all values.
   - TS `apply.ts` `applyMeta(op, strings, r)`: update `document.title`, meta description (create/update/remove), `<html lang>`; constants + `describe.ts`.
   - GTK: sync window title after each `pump_once`; description → accessible description.
   - Qt: `PLQT_SET_WINDOW_TITLE` command in `pathland_qt.h`/`qt_layer.cpp`, emitted by `QtRenderer::diff()` on change; reset clears it.

5. **Server/SSR**
   - `PathlandSession.java:364`: inject base/service-worker attrs into existing `<html …>` (currently exact `"<html>"` replacement breaks with `lang`).
   - `FrameRebase`: rebase `SET_WINDOW_METADATA`'s `B`.
   - `FrameMerger` + `ProxySession` (`:293-345`): drop window metadata from proxy snapshots/live deltas.
   - Starters: canonical/robots/sitemap remain separate host work.

6. **Demo proof**
   - `MusicPlayerView`: title `"Pathland · " + current track`, description from artist/album, locale `"en"` — track change updates the tab title live.
   - `SplitNavDemo`: title derived from `router.path()`.

7. **Remaining Lighthouse fixes (separate from this protocol work)**
   - Generic `LABEL` → `aria-label` mapping (buttons/sliders) in Rust + TS; slider accessible names.
   - `h1` via `LargeTitle`; contrast token change (`#6B7280` → `#4B5563`); `aria-hidden` on the media wrapper.
   - Host-level `/robots.txt` + `/sitemap.xml` routes (currently SPA HTML).

8. **Verification**
   - Rust golden bytes + engine “one op on change, zero unchanged”.
   - HTML head/escaping; TS head update; Java mount/SSR/route-change; rebase + proxy-drop.
   - `cargo test`, `mvn install`, TS build/tests, then axe + Lighthouse re-run.
   - Update every affected `status.md` (core, render-html, render-gtk, render-qt, Java view, Java render-html).

This keeps the wire platform-neutral: `SET_WINDOW_METADATA` describes the host surface; `<title>`/`meta description`/`lang` are only the browser renderer's mapping.

Ready to implement in this order once you leave plan mode.

**Last updated:** October 27, 2026

The **protocol core**: 16-byte opcode, SPSC ring buffers (both directions),
bump arenas (both directions), memory layout, typed events, and the golden
conformance vectors. The protocol contract is defined in `spec/`; this file
tracks what this crate implements.

## Implemented

- **Component types** (`constants.rs::component_type`): the full grouped map —
  `TEXT 0x01, IMAGE 0x02, COLOR 0x03, SHAPE 0x04, DIVIDER 0x05, SPACER 0x06,
  PROGRESS_VIEW 0x07, GAUGE 0x08, VIDEO 0x0A, ICON 0x0B, VSTACK 0x10, HSTACK 0x11, ZSTACK 0x12, GRID
0x13, SCROLLVIEW 0x14, LAZY_VGRID 0x15, LAZY_HGRID 0x16, LAZY_VSTACK 0x1B,
   LAZY_HSTACK 0x1C, GRID_ROW 0x1D, PROXY_VIEW 0x1E, BUTTON 0x20, TEXT_FIELD 0x21, TEXT_EDITOR 0x22, TOGGLE
   0x24, SLIDER 0x25, STEPPER 0x26, DATE_PICKER 0x27, PICKER 0x28, MENU 0x29,
   COLOR_PICKER 0x2A, MEDIA_CONTROLLER 0x30, COMMENT 0x7F`. (`0x09` formerly

- **Media kit** (spec/MEDIA.md): `MEDIA_CONTROLLER` (`0x30`, **non-visual**,
  layout-transparent) owns the resource + transport; a `VIDEO` (`0x0A`) surface
  references it via `MEDIA_CONTROLLER_ID` (`0x103A`). Transport properties
  `PLAYBACK_STATE` (0x1035), `MEDIA_POSITION` (0x1036), `MEDIA_VOLUME` (0x1037),
  `MEDIA_SOURCE` (0x103B), `MEDIA_MUTED` (0x103C), `MEDIA_LOOP` (0x103D),
  `MEDIA_RATE` (0x103E); the `MEDIA_*` events target the **controller** id and add
  `MEDIA_DURATION_CHANGED` (0x14). Covered by conformance vectors 39–41.
- **`PROXY_VIEW`** (`0x1E`) — a container whose child subtree is served by another
  Pathland server (spec/PROXY.md); the id is the only wire-visible part of the
  proxy contract (the origin subtree's nodes are ordinary opcodes with
  **id-remapped** node ids). Covered by conformance vector 38.
- **`GRID_COLUMNS`/`GRID_ROWS`** (`0x001E`/`0x001F`, F32) track-count properties
  for grids (positive = count, `FILL`/absent = auto-fit; never a pixel box),
  **`GRID_TRACKS`** (`0x0020`, STRING) per-track specs (takes precedence over the
  counts), and the **`GRID_ROW`** (`0x1D`) component (a grid child whose children
  are one row's cells) — all covered by conformance vectors (34–36).
- **`ALIGNMENT` (0x0002) is a 2D position code (0–8)**: `0` topLeading, `1`
  center, `2` bottomTrailing, `3` topCenter, `4` bottomCenter, `5` centerLeading,
  `6` centerTrailing, `7` topTrailing, `8` bottomLeading. Stacks read one axis

  `ZSTACK`/grids read both. Position-only — stretching is a child's `FILL`

# pathland-view (Java) — implementation status

**Last updated:** October 27, 2026

The hand-written, framework-agnostic Java 17+ DSL (`dev.pathland.view`):
declarative views, Angular-style signals, fine-grained emitter, `PLPL` wire
codec, lazy JNA ring interop, and cross-platform `State`. Protocol contract:
`spec/`. Runs on every LTS from Java 17.

## Implemented

- **`ProxyView`** (`ProxyView.make(p -> p.endpoint(...).route(...).credential(...))`):
  a `PROXY_VIEW` (0x1E) container whose child subtree is served by **another**
  Pathland server (spec/PROXY.md). It authors **no** children — the origin root is
  spliced in at runtime — and takes size modifiers like any view. The immutable
  `ProxyConfig` snapshot rides the node (`PathlandNode.proxyConfig`) and is
  surfaced to the host through `RenderResult.proxyViews()` (node id → config) so
  `pathland-server-core` opens an origin connection per proxy node. The emitter's
  internal `onStructureReconciled(Runnable)` hook (like `snapshotEmission`) fires
  after each structural reconcile — after the routing maps reflect the new subtree
  — so the host reconciles origin connections against the live `proxyViews` map
  (a proxy lives exactly while its node is in the retained tree, spec/PROXY.md §7).
- **`SizeThatFits` fit slot** (`SizeThatFits.make(Fit...)` + `Fit.of(view, minWidth)`):
  a structural slot (`SIZE_THAT_FITS` 0x17) emitting `FIT_QUERY` (LIST, ascending
  thresholds) + the single selected child — unselected candidates never transmit.
  The host routes `FIT_CHANGED` into the slot's fit sink
  (`RenderResult.fitInputs`, via `InputDispatcher`), which swaps the child through
  the structural reconcile (an unchanged index re-emits zero opcodes). The LIST
  value type is written by `FrameOpcodeSink`/`RingOpcodeSink`
  (`[count][f32 × count]` arena entries). A slot's selection is **retained node

# @pathland/dom-renderer (lib/typescript) — implementation status

**Last updated:** October 15, 2026

The **Pathland DOM renderer** — the web client. A vanilla-TypeScript hydration
client (no runtime dependencies) that is the single source of the client,
replacing the two duplicated `app.js` files in the demos. Protocol contract:
`spec/`.

## Implemented

- **Single source, unified**: `src/` is the one client; `npm run build` emits
  `dist/pathland-dom-renderer.js` (IIFE, minified via esbuild), and
  `npm run copy-to-demos` copies it into both the Quarkus and Spring Boot demos'
  static resource dirs under a **content-hashed name** (`dom-renderer-<sha256>.js`),
  pruning stale `dom-renderer-*.js` and the pre-hash literal `dom-renderer.js` (the old
  duplicated `app.js` is long since removed). A one-line pointer manifest
  `dom-renderer.current` sits next to the copies; the SSR layer reads it
  (`PathlandAssets`) to emit the right `<script src>` — the fresh URL per build busts
  the immutable asset cache without any hard refresh.
- **Per-window identity (`wid`)**: the client keeps a window id in `sessionStorage`
  (fresh per window/tab, kept across reloads of the same tab) and appends it as
  `?wid=` to the WebSocket URL (the server's per-window persisted-state scope). The
  id is **never reflected into the page URL** — the address bar/history/referrer stay
  clean — so the SSR request has no `wid` and always renders defaults. A fresh window
  needs no re-sync (its defaults match the fresh session's); a same-tab reload (or a
  load whose URL carried a stale `wid`, which the client strips) requests a
  `META::RESYNC` to restore the window's persisted state. Two windows therefore never
  share a UI model or state.
- **Property application parity**: `setNodeText` only writes `textContent` on leaf nodes

Implemented on branch `feat/window-metadata`.

**Protocol**
- `META::SET_WINDOW_METADATA` (`0x08`): field family `TITLE`/`DESCRIPTION`/`LOCALE`, string offsets, empty clears. Spec (`spec/OPCODE.md`), DSL (`spec/DSL.md`), proxy rule (`spec/PROXY.md`), and conformance vectors `44–45` added.

**Runtime metadata (all layers)**
- Java: root `windowMetadata(w -> w.title(...).description(...).locale(...))`, signal-backed, emitted at mount and per-field on change; `renderFull` re-sends. Carried by `FrameOpcodeSink` and JNA `RingOpcodeSink`.
- Rust: `Engine::bind_window_metadata`/`bind_window_field`, plus `pathland_native_window_metadata` C ABI.
- Renderers: HTML `<title>`/meta description/`<html lang>`; DOM `document.title`/meta/`lang`; GTK window title + accessible description; Qt `PLQT_SET_WINDOW_TITLE`.
- SSR: `PathlandSession` injects host attrs into `<html …>` (now that `lang` exists); `FrameRebase` rebases metadata offsets; proxy META is already dropped.

**Routes / demo**
- `MusicPlayerView` title follows the current track; `SplitNavDemo` derives title/description from `router.path()`. Verified live: clicking a track changed `document.title` from `Pathland · Building on Solid Ground` to `Pathland · Pathland Crossing`.

**Lighthouse fixes**
- Transport buttons and sliders have accessible names; `Library` is an `h1`; secondary text changed to `#4B5563`; media shell is `aria-hidden`.
- Starters now serve real `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml` routes.

**Verification**
- `cargo test --workspace` — green.
- `mvn install` (Java reactor) — green.
- TS `typecheck` + 267 tests — green.
- Local Spring demo: correct SSR title/description, valid robots/sitemap, and **axe reports zero violations** (was 6 rules).

Changes are uncommitted on the branch.
